title: Direct completion
when: Short explanations, summarization and low-risk prototypes.
risk: No live facts; validate hallucinations, formatting and provenance.
test: Try one prompt; verify three facts independently.

title: Structured extractor
when: Extract fields from variable-format texts into a strict downstream schema.
risk: Schema-valid output can still contain wrong values; add semantic checks.
test: Feed missing fields, wrong types and contradictory source text.

title: Retrieval-augmented generation
when: Answer from changing or private documents without modifying model weights.
risk: Index freshness, ACLs and source injections must be controlled.
test: Retrieve an obsolete or unauthorized version and ensure rejection.

title: Router
when: Select known specialist pipelines or models for predictable categories.
risk: Wrong classification compounds downstream error; deterministic rules may be better.
test: Route ambiguous queries and verify false branch selection is detected.

title: Fixed pipeline
flow: Step A → Step B → validate → Step C
when: Repeatable tasks with known ordering and audit checkpoints.
risk: Less flexible for novel tasks; benefit is predictable acceptance and rollback.
test: Inject a failed validation and show the next step did not run.

title: Parallel fan-out / reduce
when: Many independent subtasks or document analyses with controlled merge.
risk: Merge conflicts, duplicated side effects, extra tokens and partial failures.
test: Make one branch fail and prove aggregator reports partial output.

title: Bounded ReAct agent
flow: Model → tool → observe → repeat with limit
when: Unknown next investigation step where evidence determines the next tool.
risk: Prompt injection, loops, runaway costs; enforce scopes and stopping rules.
test: Feed the same tool error twice; verify bounded escalation.

title: Planner / executor
when: Long tasks needing decomposition, replanning and independent checks.
risk: Plans become stale when environment changes; reviews must use live proof.
test: Change an input after planning and check the replan gate.

title: Supervisor / specialists
when: Independent expert subtasks that warrant ownership separation.
risk: Coordination cost, provenance gaps and broader trust boundaries.
test: Have specialists disagree and require manager to retain evidence.

title: Human-in-the-loop
when: Irreversible, regulated, expensive or privileged operations.
risk: Pause/resume, approval freshness, exact scope and audit become central.
test: Deny approval and verify no side effects happen.

title: Durable event workflow
when: Long jobs, outages, external waiting and restart recovery.
risk: Idempotency, cancellation, concurrency and audit must be designed.
test: Timeout after remote success; verify no duplicate operation.
